violation_type.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))
violation_type.short_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides
violation_type.typical_finding: The use zone for the slides lacked the required perimeter.

finding_variants.text: The use zone for the slides lacked the required perimeter.
Two slides on the newly purchased equipment did not meet the use zone requirements.
There was a rock climbing wall directly next to the slide in the use zone.

A playscape on the playground has a ladder in the use zone of one of the slides. It also has a platform that is too tall for the age of children that use it. The operation decided that they will just no longer use this section of their outdoor space.
Use zone for toddler slide is less than minimum six feet.
A small slide with a three foot platform did not have a six foot use zone at the entrance of the slide.
